sample_unit: CABG cases in held-out test set (summaries generated)
unlisted_practices: Local, lightweight open-source LLM deployment without fine-tuning to preserve privacy
Retrieval of similar prior case summaries (RAG) to improve summary generation
Offline prompt optimization via self-adaptive feedback module
Hierarchical structuring of multisource inputs chronologically to preserve temporal accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed LLM-based pipeline (LiteMedDoc) for hospital course summarization using retrospective MIMIC-IV data and expert clinician reader evaluation, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice against an alternative.
